# Sale Badge

`promotional/sale-badge` &middot; content-level &middot; category: promotional

## Purpose

A big round or square SALE or percentage badge to sit beside or above an offer.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sub` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Red circle (square in Outlook desktop).
- **accent**: Accent-colored circle. Sets `background: @colors.accent`.
- **square**: Square badge. Sets `radius: @radius.small`.
- **large**: A larger 128px badge. Sets `size: 128px`, `textSize: 32px`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `size` | length | `"96px"` |
| `textSize` | length | `"24px"` |
| `radius` | length | `"50%"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.error"` |
| `color` | color | `"@colors.white"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.sm 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Size, color and text honored, the circle becomes a square. | Fine. | Keeps its own colors. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('promotional/sale-badge', {
  "text": "-30%",
  "sub": "this week"
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "promotional/sale-badge",
  "data": {
    "text": "-30%",
    "sub": "this week"
  }
}
```
